speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA) precipitated by gastric outlet obstruction from sleeve gastrectomy. The combination of new-onset confusion, vomiting, abdominal pain, history of recent bariatric surgery, and metabolic derangements (ketones, acidosis, hyperglycemia) confirms this diagnosis. Immediate management requires fluid resuscitation, insulin therapy, and gastric decompression.
